Package fr.univtln.bruno.samples.java101.tp1.factory

Class PersonSingleton

java.lang.Object
fr.univtln.bruno.samples.java101.tp1.factory.PersonSingleton
public final class PersonSingleton extends Object
Simple educational singleton that holds person attributes directly.

This class demonstrates a configurable singleton pattern using the initialization-on-demand idiom (double-checked locking variant here to allow explicit parameterized initialization).

Usage examples: 
   // Option A: provide parameters explicitly once before first use
   PersonSingleton.initialize("Alice", "Smith", 28);
   PersonSingleton p = PersonSingleton.getInstance();

   // Option B: use the default instance (created on first access)
   PersonSingleton p2 = PersonSingleton.getInstance();
Notes for students: - Call initialize(String,String,int) only once before first use if you want custom values; subsequent calls have no effect and return the existing instance. - The implementation is thread-safe and lazy: the instance is created only when needed.

    • initialize

      public static PersonSingleton initialize(String firstName, String lastName, int age)
      Initialize the singleton with the provided parameters. If the singleton has already been created, this call has no effect and the existing instance is returned.
      Parameters:
      firstName - person's first name (non-null)
      lastName - person's last name (non-null)
      age - person's age (non-negative)
      Returns:
      the singleton instance
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if firstName or lastName is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if age is negative
